summary: This note is a long encyclopedic overview of the human species, Homo sapiens, covering its definition and classification, evolutionary origins, history from prehistory through the contemporary era, population and habitat, and biology including anatomy, genetics, life cycle and diet. It emphasizes humans' high intelligence, social organization, cultural institutions and profound environmental impact. The excerpt ends mid-sentence in the diet section, so later material is not included.
one_line: Encyclopedic overview of Homo sapiens covering evolution, history, population, biology, life cycle and diet.
key_facts: Humans (Homo sapiens) are the most common and widespread species of primate and the last surviving species of the genus Homo.
As of March 2024, there are estimated to be more than 8 billion humans alive.
Anatomically modern humans emerged around 300,000 years ago in Africa.
Carl Linnaeus coined the name Homo sapiens in his 1735 work Systema Naturae.
The Neolithic Revolution began in Southwest Asia around 13,000 years ago and led to agriculture and permanent human settlement.
Any two humans are at least 99% genetically similar.
Humans can survive for up to eight weeks without food and several days without water.
The human genome was first sequenced in 2001.
The chromosome count of humans is 23 pairs, compared to 24 for the other apes, because chromosome 2 was formed from the joining of two other chromosomes.
The average gestation period in humans is 38 weeks.
Women live on average about four years longer than men; in 2018 global life expectancy at birth was estimated at 74.9 years for a girl and 70.4 for a boy.
Human females undergo menopause and become infertile at around the age of 50.
In 2018, 4.2 billion humans (55%) lived in urban areas, up from 751 million in 1950.
Most humans (61%) live in Asia; the remainder live in the Americas (14%), Africa (14%), Europe (11%), and Oceania (0.5%).
Humans and their domesticated animals represent 96% of all mammalian biomass on earth, whereas all wild mammals represent only 4%.
